description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling Akka-Http requests, specifically retrieving the raw request URI with considerations for Akka-Http configuration.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: Utility class for HTTP-related helper methods in Akka-Http context.

methods.name: getRawRequestUri
methods.description: Retrieves the raw request URI from an HttpRequest, returning the header value if available, otherwise falling back to the parsed URI with a warning logged.
